name: Розвиток фігур (2)
description:
In the opening phase it is very important to mobilize pieces as actively as possible. Pieces are active if they have a lot of freedom of movement. In addition, pieces like to attack important targets. In this lesson, a particular developing move is significantly better than all other alternatives. 

Also note that castling is an important developing move. By castling, you activate your rook and bring your king to safety at the same time. 

What do you have to do? 

Develop a piece to an active square, or choose castling.

examples.text: Білий кінь на b1 хоче приєднатися до гри. Найкраще поле – d2, тому що в іншому випадку кінь стояв би на шляху слона. Крім того, білі також хочуть запобігти ходу ...d5-d4 від чорних.
Чорний король у небезпеці посередині. Час змінити це за допомогою 1...0-0!

texts: Це перетворює коня на активне поле, тоді як пішак на e4 тепер добре захищений.
Розгорніть фігуру та захистіть свого центрального пішака.
The king is safe and the rook is now active.
Повний розвиток.
The bishop is on a great diagonal, combining attack with defense.
Розвивайте свої фігури.
puzzles.text: A developing move like Bd3 also seems interesting, but it's much less active because the bishop then stares at its own pawn. After 1.Bc4 Nxe4, White has the very strong 2.Qd5!.

texts: The king is relatively safe and the rook is very active here.
Choose the most active way to complete your development.
puzzles.text: A tough puzzle. The short castle also seems interesting. However, Black has 1...Bxh2+! with a very strong attack. Note that most of Black's pieces are on the kingside. The long castle is therefore better. Although Black has an active rook on b8, it cannot attack alone. The main advantage of the long castle is that the rook is now active. If you're worried about 1.0-0-0 Bxc3 2.Qxc3 Qxa2, you've calculated well. Still, White is winning here. White now has a winning attack with 3.Rxd7! after which Black cannot capture the rook due to mate on g7.

texts: The king is safer here.
Get your king safe.
White can finish development. White is ready to castle.
Develop your pieces to active squares and prepare to castle.
The king is safe and the rook is active.
"Castle your king."
This defends the knight and activates the bishop. Suddenly, the white queen has to worry.
Defend your knight and develop.
The king is safe here and the rooks are connected.
"Castle your king."
puzzles.text: Don't worry about the pawn on e4 falling. White is now threatening a mate attack with Qh6 followed by Ng5.

texts: The queen is strong here. She targets the weak pawns on d5 and b7.
Put a weak black pawn under pressure.
puzzles.text: Usually, we learn to develop the minor pieces first, but this is an exception. The queen is safe on b3 and the pawn on b7 is very vulnerable. A move like 1...Qb6 is not possible because the d5 pawn is hanging. And the move 1...b6 is very weakening, as the light squares become vulnerable.

texts: The bishop is beautifully placed here.
Develop your pieces and defend against the threat.
puzzles.text: Always stay alert. What is the opponent's plan? After 1...O-O? White has 2.e5! with a winning discovered attack.
